substats: Arena-style preset: Skill Haste first, then Skill AMP, crit rate, crit damage, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus
why: Damage and cast rate: the boss isn't accuracy-gated like stages. Most top posts reuse their arena preset.
Milk arrives sooner: one poster went 50-60G to 75.4G on lower displayed power; others see Milk come out at once.
The 428.96G run used it; one account gained 100G on Conquest gear vs 30G on arena gear, one run each.
서신우 saw no misses on his Conquest preset; 섬영's weekly best used a preset labelled 토벌.
뱅국 picks gear for power; other guides trade it for damage lines, and the move-speed case scored higher on less power.
